method: Owner counts are Avanza's 'Ägare hos Avanza', carried forward from the last observation and treated as missing after 14 days.
Group index = 100 · exp(cumulative equal-weight mean of daily log owner change); one mega-cap cannot dominate its group.
Relative index = group flow minus whole-market flow, cumulated: above 100 means the group gains owners faster than the Swedish market.
Barometer = mean defensive-group flow minus mean growth/speculative-group flow, cumulated: rising means owners rotate toward safety.
Rotation quadrant: x = relative index vs its 13-week mean, y = 4-week change of x.
Projection = 13-week log-linear trend extrapolated 8 weeks with an 80% band. Descriptive and unvalidated: no backtest yet shows owner flow predicts group returns.
